query:
SELECT t.id FROM tenants t
           WHERE t.status = 'active'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM malware_scans s
                 WHERE s.tenant_id = t.id
                   AND (s.state IN ('queued', 'running')
                        OR s.requested_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $1::int))
             )
           ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT $2
